final: WITH j AS (SELECT p.throws AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award m JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM j), s AS (SELECT j.hand, j.cnt, j.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM j CROSS JOIN t), a AS (SELECT AVG(s.share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS dev FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(k.cnt) AS kept_count_sum, AVG(k.share) AS kept_share_avg, AVG(k.dev) AS kept_dev_avg FROM k
